row.evidence: Microsoft documents no SCIM service-provider endpoint for Microsoft 365; users are provisioned through Microsoft Graph (POST /users), and the only SCIM-shaped intake, the Entra /bulkUpload inbound provisioning API, "is available with Microsoft Entra ID P1, P2, and Microsoft Entra ID Governance licenses."
row.notes: Status changed from free (June) to none, and this needs a reviewer decision. June scored Microsoft as the IdP (Entra's outbound SCIM to other apps), which is not what this index measures. Looked at as a target app, Microsoft 365 has no standard SCIM /Users endpoint. IdPs (Okta's Microsoft Office 365 app, Google Workspace autoprovisioning) provision through Microsoft's own APIs, so under rule 3 the status is none with api_provisioning true. Okta's OIN page does tick 'SCIM' for its Office 365 app (see conflicts). Microsoft does offer API-driven inbound provisioning: an asynchronous Graph /bulkUpload endpoint that takes SCIM-schema bulk payloads, needs Entra ID P1/P2/Governance (P1 comes with Business Premium) and is meant for HR or system-of-record feeds, not a generic SCIM client. If a reviewer counts that as SCIM, the row becomes gated at Business Premium ($32/u/mo with Copilot). Price change: Business Basic rose from $6 to $7/u/mo (annual), as June predicted. Business Standard with Copilot is $23.50 and Business Premium with Copilot is $32. The June pricing URL (compare-all-plans) now returns 404 and redirects to plans-and-pricing. Deleting a user via Graph soft-deletes them for 30 days. After that, licences are freed.

plans.name: Business Premium with Copilot
plans.notes: Includes advanced identity and access management with Microsoft Entra ID (P1-level), which unlocks the SCIM-schema /bulkUpload inbound provisioning API.

limitations.text: SCIM-schema /bulkUpload inbound provisioning requires Entra ID P1, P2 or Governance and is throttled at 40 calls per 5 seconds.

scim.notes: No SCIM 2.0 service-provider (/Users) endpoint is documented for Microsoft 365. The closest is Entra API-driven inbound provisioning: an asynchronous Graph /bulkUpload endpoint that accepts SCIM-schema bulk payloads (OAuth token, Entra ID P1/P2/Governance). It is not counted as a generic SCIM endpoint here.

capabilities.notes: deactivate = PATCH accountEnabled=false; reactivate here = restore a soft-deleted user (or set accountEnabled=true).

okta.notes: Okta-built 'Microsoft Office 365' OIN app with Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push. The OIN filter ticks 'SCIM', but Microsoft documents no SCIM endpoint for Microsoft 365, so the connector is recorded as API-based.

entra.notes: Microsoft 365 users live natively in Microsoft Entra ID; no separate catalogue app applies.

google.notes: Google Workspace autoprovisioning to Office 365; requires SSO set up first.

fallbacks.other_sync: Entra API-driven inbound provisioning (/bulkUpload, SCIM-schema bulk payloads, Entra ID P1+)

conflicts.text: Okta's OIN page ticks 'SCIM' under Functionality for its Microsoft Office 365 app, while Microsoft documents only Graph APIs and the SCIM-schema /bulkUpload inbound API (Entra P1+) for provisioning, with no SCIM /Users endpoint.

open_questions: Whether the SCIM-schema /bulkUpload inbound provisioning API should count as SCIM (that would make the row gated at Entra ID P1 / Business Premium).
Which Microsoft 365 plans allow federation with a third-party SAML/WS-Fed IdP (sso_plan); not stated on the pricing page.
Whether Graph user-management APIs carry any plan restriction (believed none, but not stated on the pages loaded).
OneLogin and JumpCloud Office 365 connector pages were not checked.
